controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T17:05:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T21:05:57.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule = falco.rule,
           proc = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
